Hi Alex — thanks for the logs and payload. A few quick checks we recommend before the live session (fast to try):

- Confirm Authorization header is "Bearer <token>" and that token has rerank scope (scope: "rerank:write" in our tokens). Mistyped header can cause retries and upstream 5xxs.
- Try pinning the request to a single model variant to avoid routing to fallback clusters: add header X-Redwood-Model: redwood-reranker-v1-stable.
- Increase SDK client timeout to 15s, or set streaming to false while we debug full-batch reranking.
- If your payload includes long tool-calling prompts or structured-output schema, try a reduced schema to rule out serialization size issues.

Quick repro curl (replace token & payload path):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Model: redwood-reranker-v1-stable" \
  --data-binary @sample-payload.json \
  --max-time 15

If you can share the SDK version and exact token scopes, we'll try reproducing this today on our staging with the same batch sizes. Looking at the logs you attached, there are repeated CONNECT attempts which can point to transient routing or capacity fallbacks.

—Marissa
